title: Another Development Milestone Achieved..!
author: BeyondAffinity
selftext:
tl;dr: The LLM-Driven pipeline I built starting with this project is being used for all my other games now. It's Claude Code based harness-heavy pipeline that just mimics my experience in past game companies I used to work. And because it's built to mimic that, me doing tight design specification was more than enough to release large feature like this without a hassle.  
  
Because my game is a straight-up-Balatro-like, everything should directly & indirectly support the replayability of the game, and it had been one of the many core goals in terms of design principles of this game.

Since it has an explicit theme of going to a mage school as a beginning mage selling the fact each mode represent each school of magic was pretty straight forward.  
**However**, the hard part was selling how the different modes were worth visiting by mechanics not by themes. For some players, just a tad-bit of different rule set per mode might be enough, but I was still skeptical. Hence this signature spell per school was designed by necessity, and finally got to finish it(I'm so happy DX)! Now I am quite confident each game mode provides quite different gameplay experiences while playing within the larger same rules that is playing and breaking Yahtzee.

There are a lot of interesting/intriguing roguelikes out there nowadays, but I tend to like non-action roguelikes better in both making it and playing it. And Making this kind of replayability design was really something I cherish about it since I think it's much harder to express that in non-action roguelikes than action oriented roguelikes.
